title.narrative: UNICEF Guinea-Bissau enhanced WASH infrastructure in 2024, improving access to water, sanitation, and hygiene services. Through effective Community-Led Total Sanitation (CLTS) interventions, solar-powered water systems and gender-sensitive sanitation facilities, UNICEF improved health and education outcomes for 49,800 beneficiaries (25,740 female), including 15,569 in communities verified as Open Defecation Free (ODF) for the first time.
